## IGramstaxStartOptions type

Parsed `gramstax start` flags.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IGramstaxStartOptions = {
```

## Remarks

Produced by `GramstaxStart._parseArgv` from `--deploy <mode>` and `--watch`<!-- -->. All fields optional — an empty object boots with config defaults and no watcher.
